assessments.reasoning: Page 16 distinguishes program, data and procedure modules, gives examples of the first two grammar categories, and states that program and data modules are units of compilation. It describes procedure modules nested in program modules.

challenge.method: Compare the printed prose to the preceding grammar, testing whether a procedure body implies a separate compilation unit. Compare the 1972 MPS and Mesa 5.0 compilation categories.
challenge.results: The page explicitly says a procedure module is not defined as its own syntactic unit and locates its declaration inside the enclosing program. The MPS and Mesa manuals are different materials with separately scoped categories.

limitations: No actual compiler or emulator was run. The finding applies to the exact February 1974 MPL(B) text.
